issues.extracted: General Fund column amounts used for lines 1100-3551
issues.on_page: Right half of the first governmental disbursements page (report p9: Special Building, QCPUF, Educational Leasing Corp, Reclass and Total Governmental Funds columns for lines 1100-3551) is not in the trimmed PDF; trimmed p9 is the right half of report p10 only
issues.issue: The Total Governmental Funds column for these lines can't be checked, and it does not equal the General Fund column. The Statement of Activities (p2) shows the whole (1,290,885) Reclass sits on these lines: Instruction 6,491,181 vs GF lines 6,541,181 (-50,000); Pupil support 768,072 vs 946,073 (-178,001); Support services business 597,524 vs 751,524 (-154,000); Maintenance and operations 1,123,881 vs 1,882,165 (-758,284); Pupil transportation 249,122 vs 399,722 (-150,600). So the per-line amounts in disbursements[0..40] for those groups are GF-column figures, not Total-column figures. The page needs re-trimming.

issues.on_page: Line 5000 Debt related costs: Reclass column '-', Total 1,672,186; Statement of Activities p2 Debt service 1,672,186
issues.issue: The page doesn't print this split. The Reclass column shows nothing on the 5000 line, and the government-wide Debt service figure keeps the full 1,672,186. The ELC's own debt payment of 691,284 stays in the total. What the reclass removes is the General Fund's payments to the ELC, which are hidden in the GF function lines (instruction, pupil support, business, maintenance, transportation; see the p2 differences). As recorded, debt service is understated by 691,284 and support services/instruction/transportation are overstated. The notes also say the ELC lease revenue is on row 1960; p6 shows ELC 691,284 and Reclass (691,284) on row 1990, Miscellaneous local receipts.

issues.on_page: Reclass (1,290,885) total; p2 Statement of Activities gives the reduction by function
issues.issue: The contra for the hidden GF-to-Depreciation transfer is booked to 'other'. The p2 function totals show the reclass comes out of instruction, support services and student transportation, though they don't show how the 599,601 transfer and the 691,284 ELC payments split among them. The category is defensible, but the function-level spending stays overstated.

issues.on_page: Miscellaneous revenues (code 1960), Total 7,452; the Bond Fund budget schedule p18 shows 7,452 as Public power district sales tax
issues.issue: The label has '(1960)' added, which the page doesn't print. The category comes from the budget schedule's relabeling, while the extractor rules map 1960-code lines to intergovernmental/state aid. The review note also wrongly says the 691,284 ELC reclass nets on this row; it is on row 1990.

issues.on_page: County fees and licenses 37,758 (GF schedule p14: County fines and license fees)
issues.issue: This is money passed through from the county, so the category is defensible. But the label names fines and licenses, which could be fines and forfeitures or licenses and permits. Same for detail[8].

issues.on_page: Interfund loan (9002) 39,922; disbursement 9004 Interfund Loan to QCPUF Fund 39,922
issues.issue: An interfund loan between two governmental funds (Bond to QCPUF) is recorded as a receipt and a disbursement in 'other'. It matches the printed totals and nets to zero, but under the rules it is loan or other-financing activity, not revenue or spending. Same for disbursements[53], detail[64] and detail[70].

issues.on_page: School Activities Fund statement p12 (receipts 409,498, disbursements 398,750, per-account lines), Student Fees Fund p13 (receipts 6,017, disbursements 3,170), budget schedules p20 and p22
issues.issue: Skipped as fiduciary-type because these funds aren't in net position or the governmental totals, but the pages don't say they are fiduciary. The rules call for per-account student activity detail when such a schedule is printed.
